fact: The Electoral Commission of Seychelles FAQ says voters can check their name on the register by SMS of their NIN to 9600, on www.ecs.sc, or at the nearest registration centre.

The Electoral Commission of Seychelles FAQ says it receives a monthly list of deceased from the Department of Immigration and Civil Status and removes those names from the voters' register at certification, and that the NIN is used to check the register.
The Electoral Commission of Seychelles says voters can use its new Online Voter Registration system at ecs.sc to check their registration status or register, transfer, correct, change name or object.
